titulo: Three people dead, including a child, in attempt to cross Channel to UK
cuerpo: Dozens also reported injured after inflatable boat carrying 105 people gets into trouble off northern France A child was among three people who died ⁠and dozens of others who were injured while ⁠attempting ​to cross the Channel on Monday, French authorities have said.
